requirement:
The authoring harness MUST use Rig and support Bedrock, Ollama, and OpenAI. Users MUST be
able to select a backend and model through configuration without changing the
assessment tools, prompt, or evidence format.
rationale:
## Obligations and implementation

`requirements.authoring.provider` requires the harness to (1) use Rig, support (2) Bedrock, (3) Ollama, and (4) OpenAI, allow configuration selection of (5) backend and (6) model, without changing (7) assessment tools, (8) prompt, or (9) evidence format.

- **Rig and all three backends:** `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[configured_record]` calls `RigProvider::connect`. Its reachable implementation, `src/authoring/providers.rs#impl[RigProvider]/fn[connect]`, constructs Rig Bedrock completion, Ollama native completion, or OpenAI Responses models from the configured backend and model, erasing them into the common model held by `src/authoring/providers.rs#struct[RigProvider]`. `src/authoring/providers.rs#impl[RigProvider/CompletionProvider]` executes requests through that Rig model.
- **Configuration selection:** `configured_record` passes `config.backend` to `connect`; `connect` matches the backend variant and supplies its configured model to the corresponding Rig constructor. `src/config.rs#enum[BackendConfig]`, reachable through that parameter type, deserializes the lowercase `backend` discriminator into the three supported variants.
- **Unchanged tools, prompt, and evidence format:** `configured_record` sends the selected provider through the shared `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[assess_subject]` and `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[assess]` path. `assess` prepares the prompt and records evidence independently of backend selection. `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[converse]` installs the shared tool definitions and dispatches tool calls through the same assessment machinery. Provider-specific request handling is confined to the adapter rather than requiring different assessment inputs or evidence formats.

## Tests

`tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[all_adapters_preserve_prompt_tools_and_evidence_with_default_connections]` carries the required subject test reference and exercises all three configured backends against local servers. It asserts the selected model in each backend's request, successful assessment, equality of normalized prompts and complete tool definitions, and equality of the entire evidence documents. Its reachable helper, `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[prompt_and_tools]`, removes provider envelopes while retaining tool names, descriptions, and schemas. These are substantive assertions for all nine obligations, including the explicit unchanged-format obligations.

Additional subject-marked tests verify configured Ollama model selection (`tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[authoring_uses_nearest_workspace_configuration_without_a_user_file]`), Bedrock model selection and source-tool execution (`tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[bedrock_cli_uses_selected_profile_region_and_converse_tools]`), and OpenAI model selection and tool-history replay (`tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[openai_responses_replays_tool_calls_and_records_usage]`). No testing exemption is needed.

The implementation and its required tests are reachable from the supplied references. No gap was found.
